description: This Java source file defines the class TestCommandResponse, which is a subtype of AbstractCommandResponse, intended for handling responses to specific commands in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances, accessing entity IDs, resource paths, and resource types, and serializing payloads to JSON.

classes.name: TestCommandResponse
classes.description: A response class for a test command within the Eclipse Ditto framework, providing methods for creating instances, setting headers, and retrieving entity information.
